limitations: This identity is for the MVS language documented in the exact February issue. z/OS is the documented platform. JES controls, other JCL variants, in-stream utility input and later revisions have separate scope.

statement: IBM's February 2025 z/OS 3.1 reference identifies MVS Job Control Language as a language for specifying job control. It distinguishes JCL statements from JES2 and JES3 Job Entry Control Language statements.
